steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to Ghost admin at http://127.0.0.1:8099/ghost/ with email admin@bench.local and password {{env:APP_PASSWORD}} (type the password literally as that placeholder text). Then go to the Posts list, and report the titles of all published posts whose title starts with 'Seed:', exactly as shown.

02-create: In Ghost admin, create a new post titled exactly '{{runid}} Bench Post'. In the body editor type exactly one paragraph: 'This bench post was created for run {{runid}}.' (only once, no duplicate paragraph). Save it as a draft (do not publish yet). Report the title shown in the editor and confirm the body paragraph appears exactly once.

03-open: Open the draft post '{{runid}} Bench Post' in Ghost admin and open its post settings panel. In the settings: (1) set the tags to ONLY the existing tag 'Bench News' — pick it from the tag field's suggestion dropdown, do NOT create a new tag, and make sure no other tag like 'Bench Newsletter' is attached; (2) set the custom excerpt to text that includes the runid '{{runid}}', e.g. 'Bench post for run {{runid}}.'; (3) set the publish date to 2026-09-01 (date 2026-09-01, keep a valid time); (4) report the URL slug exactly as shown in the settings panel. Save/apply the settings and report the tag, excerpt, publish date and slug as the app shows them after saving.

04-verify: In Ghost admin, publish the post '{{runid}} Bench Post' so it ends up PUBLISHED (not draft, not scheduled) and visible to the public. Click Publish, choose 'Publish' (right now, not scheduling), confirm the publish flow, and wait for it to complete. Then verify: the post's status is Published, its publish date is still 2026-09-01, and it appears in the Published posts list. If Ghost would instead schedule the post because the date is in the future, adjust so it publishes now while keeping the publish date 2026-09-01, and report what you had to do. Report the final status, publish date, and whether the post appears in the Published list.

05-report: Final verification of the post '{{runid}} Bench Post' in Ghost. Check and report each of these as the app shows them: (1) in the post editor settings panel: the exact URL slug, the tags (list all attached tags), the custom excerpt text, and the publish date; (2) the post's status (Published / {{02-create.post_status}} / Scheduled) as shown in the editor header; (3) in the body editor, the paragraph text and that it appears exactly once (no duplicated paragraph); (4) the public page at http://127.0.0.1:8099/{{runid}}-bench-post/ — report its HTTP status and whether the title, body paragraph, tag 'Bench News', excerpt and date 01 Sep 2026 are visible there; (5) the Published posts list — report all titles shown. Do not change anything.
